note: Colours for the world around the port (M14): the planet skirt beyond the desert, the outpost placeholder, and the sky in space. Read by src/systems/world/world_scenery.gd and src/systems/world/altitude_sky.gd.

draw_distance.note: Less to draw the further it is from the camera: the ground-level partner of the altitude tiers (content/core/worlds/<id>.json 'detail'). Read by src/systems/look/draw_distance.gd for the systems scenes/town_demo.gd watches. Each rule maps a mesh's size (metres corner to corner, world scale) to the distance it stops being drawn: [under_m, end_m] pairs, smallest first; a mesh as big as the last 'under' or bigger is always drawn (buildings, hulls, landforms). Its lights fade out from light_m (or reach_x times their reach, if that is further) over light_fade_m. outdoor: the numbers the camps (120 m trim, 220 m props) and the wreck field (1500 m for parts under 6 m) already used. interior: the barge's (props 140 m, lights 90 m), for rooms you only see from close by. person: anything that walks (NPCs, droids, animals), drawn as far as the outposts keep their soldiers awake (320 m). orbit: the cruiser, a landmark from the air with its lights inside. A mesh or light that already has its own range keeps it.

dust.note: Issue #93: blowing sand round the camera (src/systems/look/dust_wind.gd). grains: single grains of sand flying downwind, each wandering on its own (turbulence: how hard the air pushes them about, turbulence_scale: the size of those eddies, turbulence_influence: how much each grain follows them); puffs: slow soft clouds. box = half-width of the emitting box (m), height = its height above the ground, width/length = the quad (m), speed in m/s, alpha = opacity. gust_rate: how often the wind gusts (noise frequency per second); lull: how much dust is left between gusts (0..1). The sand shader's wind_strength makes the matching sheets on the ground.
